meaning: Rows the pinned reactor's property database lacks (it holds H2, N2, NH3 only). The adapter merges them into a copy of the pinned src/reactor/data/properties_database.json read from the pinned checkout at run time; the group's file is never copied into this repository. 'copy_from' names a row of that pinned file whose columns are copied (the transport surrogate).

provenance.Ar c_p: 5/2 R exactly (monatomic ideal gas; NASA TM-4513's Ar low range is the same constant)
provenance.CH4 c_p: relative least-squares fit of the DIPPR-107 form with C3 = 2000 K and C5 = 1000 K fixed (M01's choice) to NASA TM-4513's c_p on 250-1000 K step 5 K; C1, C2, C4 rounded to 6 significant digits; max relative deviation 0.00424
provenance.transport columns and binary rows: surrogates copied from the pinned database's N2 row and N2 pairs (M01's choice; its effect is measured by the reactor probe's inert-transport variant)
